description: 对话练习：项目式学习三个阶段的完整内容，角色扮演跟读

sections.title: Part 1 — Home survey（家居环境调查）

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Hi, I'm Lily. Let's do a home survey today.
lines.chinese: 嗨，我是Lily。今天我们来做一个家居调查吧。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We want to find out how green our home is.
lines.chinese: 我们想弄清楚我们的家有多环保。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: First, let's look at the kitchen.
lines.chinese: 首先，让我们看看厨房。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: My mum uses plastic bags when she goes shopping. That's not very green.
lines.chinese: 我妈妈购物时使用塑料袋。那不是很环保。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: And we have only one rubbish bin. We don't sort the rubbish.
lines.chinese: 而且我们只有一个垃圾桶。我们不分类垃圾。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Next, let's look at the bathroom.
lines.chinese: 接下来，让我们看看卫生间。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Sometimes my dad leaves the tap running when he brushes his teeth.
lines.chinese: 有时候我爸爸刷牙时让水龙头一直流着。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: That wastes a lot of water.
lines.chinese: 那浪费很多水。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Now let's look at the living room.
lines.chinese: 现在让我们看看客厅。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We often leave the lights on when no one is in the room.
lines.chinese: 房间里没人时我们经常让灯亮着。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: And we have a lot of old things that we don't use any more.
lines.chinese: 而且我们有很多不再使用的旧物品。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Hmm... our home is not very green yet. But we can change that!
lines.chinese: 嗯……我们的家还不是很环保。但是我们可以改变它！

sections.title: Part 2 — Green home plan（绿色家园计划）

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: To make our home greener, we have a three-part plan.
lines.chinese: 为了让我们的家更环保，我们制定了一个三部分的计划。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: First, we will save energy and water.
lines.chinese: 第一，我们要节约能源和水。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We will turn off lights when we leave a room.
lines.chinese: 我们离开房间时会关灯。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We will turn off the tap when we brush our teeth.
lines.chinese: 我们刷牙时会关掉水龙头。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Second, we will reduce waste and recycle more.
lines.chinese: 第二，我们要减少浪费，更多地回收利用。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We will use cloth bags instead of plastic bags.
lines.chinese: 我们要用布袋代替塑料袋。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We will get three rubbish bins for different kinds of rubbish.
lines.chinese: 我们要买三个垃圾桶来放不同种类的垃圾。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We will recycle paper, plastic and glass.
lines.chinese: 我们要回收纸、塑料和玻璃。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Third, we will reuse old things and give them new life.
lines.chinese: 第三，我们要重复利用旧物品，给它们新生命。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We can make pencil holders with old cans.
lines.chinese: 我们可以用旧易拉罐做笔筒。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We can make shopping bags with old T-shirts.
lines.chinese: 我们可以用旧T恤做购物袋。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We can use old jars to store food.
lines.chinese: 我们可以用旧罐子储存食物。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Small changes make a big difference.
lines.chinese: 小小的改变带来大大的不同。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We believe our home will become better and better.
lines.chinese: 我们相信我们的家园会变得越来越好。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Welcome to our "Better Home" showcase!
lines.chinese: 欢迎来到我们的「更好的家园」展示会！

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: I'm Lily and this is my green home project.
lines.chinese: 我是Lily，这是我的绿色家园项目。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Our home was not very green before.
lines.chinese: 我们的家以前不是很环保。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We wasted a lot of water and electricity.
lines.chinese: 我们浪费很多水和电。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We used too many plastic bags and we didn't recycle.
lines.chinese: 我们用了太多塑料袋，而且我们不做回收。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: But now things are different.
lines.chinese: 但是现在情况不同了。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We made a green home plan and we stuck to it.
lines.chinese: 我们制定了一个绿色家园计划，并且坚持执行。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Look at these pencil holders! We made them with old cans.
lines.chinese: 看这些笔筒！我们用旧易拉罐做的。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: And this shopping bag! We made it with an old T-shirt.
lines.chinese: 还有这个购物袋！我们用一件旧T恤做的。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We also made this pretty picture with old buttons.
lines.chinese: 我们还用旧纽扣做了这幅漂亮的画。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Old things can have new life!
lines.chinese: 旧物可以有新生！

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Now our home is greener and more beautiful.
lines.chinese: 现在我们的家更环保、更美丽了。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: We will keep working to make our home even better.
lines.chinese: 我们将继续努力，让我们的家园变得更好。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.english: Thank you for visiting our showcase!
lines.chinese: 谢谢你们参观我们的展示会！
